### ⛔ The governed-surface rules, which are absolute here

`CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` are **named items** on this repo's governed surface. So:

1. ⛔ **Open the PR as draft and leave it draft.** Do not flip it ready. **This seat will not arm it either** — a human merges it, and the human merge *is* the review record.
2. ⛔ **Do not call `update_pull_request` to add a reviewer.** ⚠️ That endpoint sends `draft: false` alongside a reviewers-only update — it published a governed-surface draft (`AGENTS.md`, PR #6183) straight into the merge queue earlier today, where it merged **without human review**. Filed as objectstack#12200 and decision card #6325.
3. ⭐ Instead, **@-mention `os-zhuang` in the PR body** to request the review. A mention notifies without touching draft state.

### The work

Port the repair from the merged upstream PR **objectstack#11934**: an explicit **`git fetch origin main`** plus an **`origin/main`** base at each recipe site. The defect is that `git worktree add ../REPO-TASK -b BRANCH main` bases the new branch on a **bare local `main`** — a ref nothing in the recipe fetches, so on a shared checkout whose `main` is stale (or was moved by another agent) the worktree starts from the wrong commit.

⚠️ **Re-measure the drift on THIS repo's shared checkout for the PR body.** ⛔ Do not relay the upstream numbers — the card's own unlock note re-verified the premise here rather than trusting the upstream reading, and you should do the same.

⭐ **Read objectstack#11934's diff before writing yours** — its **site-by-site in/out judgment** is the template, including its note that this repo's copy was **deliberately left to this card**. Some recipe sites there were judged out of scope; understand why before deciding which of this repo's sites are in.

⚠️ Both `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` carry the recipe here, and `AGENTS.md` §9 carries the fuller statement. Check both, and check whether any `.claude/` doc repeats it — ⛔ `.claude/**` is governed too, so the same draft-only rule applies to anything you touch there.

### Constraints

- ⛔ **Worktree-first**: `git worktree add ../objectui-6208 -b claude/issue-6208-worktree-recipe-fetch-base main && cd ../objectui-6208 && pnpm install`. ⭐ Yes — the recipe you are fixing is the recipe you must follow to fix it. Use it as written for now; your change lands for the next agent.
- ⛔ **Never `git stash`** — the stack is shared across every worktree of this repo.
- ⛔ **Never touch `content/docs/releases/`.**
- ⛔ Do not set `domain:*` or type labels; file findings **unassigned**.
- ⚠️ Run the **whole** `scripts/__tests__` tree — several gates pin instruction-file content, and a subset chosen from your own subject matter will miss the ones that fire on a file as a whole.
- Changeset required (empty frontmatter — instruction files ship no package).

### Reporting

Structured JSON report: the drift re-measured **on this repo** with commands, every recipe site you found and your **in/out judgment for each** with its reason, what objectstack#11934's template did differently and why, confirmation the PR is **draft** with `os-zhuang` mentioned **in the body**, and the full-tree test counts.

⛔ Report back even though nothing will be armed. This seat records it under "awaiting a human merge" — the outcome is a PR waiting for a person, not a landed change.

## Review — ACCEPT (PR #6449). ⛔ Governed surface: **held for a human merge, not armed.**

Reviewed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`, R35.

### ⚠️ My dispatch order contained a bad instruction, and the dev was right to refuse it

I wrote: *"⭐ Yes — the recipe you are fixing is the recipe you must follow to fix it. **Use it as written for now**."* That was cute and it was **wrong**. The dev measured before obeying:

| reading | value |
|:--|--:|
| local `main` behind `origin/main` | **473 commits** |
| age gap | **116.8 hours** |
| `AGENTS.md` drift, `main…origin/main` | **109 lines** |
| ⭐ positive control `rev-list --count origin/main..main` | **0** — strict lag, not divergence |

⛔ Following my instruction would have written this repair **onto a 109-line-stale copy of the very file it repairs**. The dev based the worktree on a freshly fetched `origin/main` instead and **declared the deviation** in the PR body rather than doing it quietly. ⭐ That is the correct handling of an order that the evidence contradicts, and the 473 is the argument — not a preference.

⭐ And the honest footnote on its own fetch: *"the explicit `git fetch origin main` moved `origin/main` 0 commits here, because another agent had fetched ten minutes earlier: **luck, not a guarantee, which is why the fetch is in the recipe.**"* A measurement that came out uninteresting, reported with why it still matters.

### ⭐ Four sites, not the two the card named — and the two extra are the ones agents actually read

`CLAUDE.md:16` and `AGENTS.md:234` were named. The dev also found **`.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.sh:57`** and **`guard-main-checkout-bash.sh:544`** — ⭐ **the recipe the two worktree guards *print* when they block an edit.**

Those have **no upstream counterpart** (objectstack's guards do not print the recipe), so the template could not have suggested them — and they are arguably the **most-followed copy in the repo**, because they reach an agent at the exact moment it needs the command and is looking for something to paste. ⛔ A port that copied upstream's site list would have fixed the documentation and left the thing agents obey.

Site-by-site in/out with a reason each, including five **OUT** with justification (the `-cmp` lines take an explicit ref from the caller; the selftest builds a throwaway repo with no shared checkout to be stale against; two prose mentions carry no recipe). ⭐ And a **residual check**: after the change, `grep -rn 'worktree add' … | grep -v origin/main` returns **exactly the three OUT sites and nothing else** — so the claim "every in-scope site is repaired" is measured, not asserted.

### Upstream differences established rather than assumed

⭐ *"upstream both governed files sat at shrink-only ratchet ceilings … This repo has **NO** line ratchet on `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` — **measured, not assumed**: no `CEILINGS` map covers them and no workflow measures their length."* It then held **net ±0 lines on all four files anyway**. Checking whether the upstream constraint even exists here, instead of inheriting the constraint or ignoring it, is the difference between porting a change and porting a change's circumstances.

The second half of #11934 (teaching `dispatch-gates.mjs` to announce a stale tree) **does not exist here** — `scripts/pm/` holds only `check-half-states.mjs` — so there is nothing to port, and that is stated rather than silently dropped.

⭐ And `skip-changeset` was **not** applied: *"that label is not a real mechanism in this repo (no workflow reads it — see #4912)."* Second dev tonight to recognise #4912's harm unprompted and decline to mint it.

### ⛔ Governance — the part I care about most on this card

> PR #6449 read back from the API: **`"draft": true`**. `os-zhuang` is **@-mentioned in the body**, not requested via the API. **`update_pull_request` was never called** — no reviewer parameter was passed to `create_pull_request` either, for the same `draft:false` reason recorded on PR #6183 / objectstack#12200 / #6325. Nothing armed, nothing queued.

⭐ Read back from the API rather than assumed from intent. That is the check that would have caught the #6183 violation on the day it happened.

### Verification

Whole tree, after the final commit: **81 files / 2318 tests**, exit 0 under the shared lock. ⭐ **Both hook self-tests re-run because `.claude/hooks/*.sh` changed** — 121 and 41 cases. Gate families derived from *this* repo's `package.json` and workflows, ⛔ explicitly **not** from `dispatch-gates.mjs`, *"because it is objectstack-only and would answer about the wrong repo."*

⭐ *"NOT MEASURED, stated rather than glossed: `guard-main-checkout.sh` has no self-test in this repo, so its edited line is pinned by nothing"* — filed as **#6451**. Plus **#6452**, that this repo never documents GitHub's body-sanitizer stripping of angle-bracket placeholders, measured live on this card's own body.

### Disposition

⛔ **Not armed and never will be by this seat.** `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/**` are all governed surface — all four edited files are on it. PR #6449 stays **draft**, `os-zhuang` is mentioned in the body, and **the human merge is the review record**. Recorded under *awaiting a human merge* in the stand-down brief.
